generate_warp_types: generate MJX warp types by running the CLI script to produce types.py from mjwarp annotations
write_core_cls: write a core API class like Model, Data, Option, or Statistic to the types output file
write_nested_dataclass: write a nested dataclass like TileSet or BlockDim to the generated types file
write_register_vmappable: write register_vmappable registration for DataWarp with JAX batching support
write_ndim_annotations: write ndim annotations dictionary for every warp field across Model, Data, Option, and Statistic
